messages:
Claire: heads-up: while doing the quickstart refresh i noticed the Node and Go examples diverged on how credentials are loaded. Node uses process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY but the Go example still documents a raw token string in code. we should standardize to env + tiny migration note.
Jun: thanks. i can fix the Go snippet to use os.Getenv and update the node shell example to `export REDWOOD_API_KEY` instead of `REDWOOD_TOKEN`.
Priya: also can we add a short safety sentence: "avoid hardcoding API keys in source; use env or a secrets manager" — keeps legal happy.
Claire: yes, one-liner is enough. also add a quick note in the troubleshooting section about `403` errors pointing to wrong key name. saw a user hit it during onboarding.
Tom: i'll prep a patch with both snippets and a tiny migration blurb (v8 SDK): explain that client constructors now accept api_key kwarg and that env var name changed. will open PR `docs/quickstart-cred-unify` in a few.
Jun: while you do that, can you run the snippets through the exec harness locally? `make docs-serve` + `yarn docs:exec` repro'd a fail earlier for Go due to missing imports. i can paste the exact command in the PR template.
Tom: good call. i'll include `go get ./... && go test ./snippets` in the PR checklist for Go snippets. added to my branch.
Priya: copyedit: prefer phrasing "Set REDWOOD_API_KEY in your environment (recommended)" rather than imperative only. small tone thing.
Tom: pushed PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912 — includes: node + go snippet updates, migration note, troubleshooting 403 callout, contributor checklist for local snippet validation.
DocsBot: PR 912 preview build failed: snippet-exec returned exit code 1 for `snippets/hello/go.md` line 18 (missing package import). logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/912/logs
Jun: repro'd. forgot `import "os"` in the Go sample. also `NewClient` signature changed to `NewClientWithAPIKey` in the sample i copied from an older branch. i'll send a tiny patch on the PR.
Tom: thanks. pushed fix `docs/quickstart-cred-unify+fix` — updated imports and constructor to `client := redwood.NewClient(redwood.WithAPIKey(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY")))`. also updated snippet exec harness config to include GOPATH.
DocsBot: build/preview passed for PR 912  live preview: https://deploy-preview-912--docs.redwood.ai/snippets/hello
Priya: quick read-through done, a couple word tweaks and one more nit on code fence language labels (node example used `javascript` but our linter wants `js`).
Claire: perfect. approve and merge once backported to `stable`. add short changelog line under docs release notes for this week.
Tom: merged and backported. changelog note: "Quickstart: unify credential examples (Node/Go) and add SDK v8 migration guidance." closing thread. :white_check_mark:
